instructions: 0.1.0; English edition. Compatible with the Chinese workbook; do not rename input sheets or headers.
Fill the amber-headed fields in Reaction contexts. Include the protein scaffold for enzymatic records. Initially, detailed conditions can stay together in Conditions as reported.
One reaction mode, catalytic system and set of conditions. Create a new Context ID for changes in metal, light, solvent or procedure. Substrate and variant changes usually create a new assay.
One row per metric in Measurements. Yield, ee and TTN from the same experiment share an Assay ID but have different Measurement IDs.
Group one reported reaction capability under one Discovery event ID. Fifty substrates or one hundred variants are not fifty or one hundred discoveries.
Prioritize a representative reaction, initial activity, the best evolved variant and informative negative controls. You do not need the entire substrate or mutant library in the first pass.
Record compound labels and the exact main-text or SI location. Leave Reaction SMILES blank and choose Structure pending if needed. Manual atom mapping is not required.
Enter the plain number 85 with unit % for 85 percent. Do not type Excel 85%. For <1%, enter 1, qualifier <, unit %. Preserve the original expression as well.
For 95:5 dr, select metric dr and put 95:5 in Result as reported. Leave Numeric value blank. This avoids interpreting a ratio as a decimal or time.
Enter zero only when reported. Keep n.d. in Result as reported and select Not detected. Use Not reported for missing reporting. An experiment absent from the literature is not a failed experiment.
Separate Native metal and cofactor, Actual metal and cofactor, and Metal installation method. Do not infer the active oxidation state or catalytic cycle from the added salt.
Check preprints as well as journal publication. If only the year is known, leave the date blank and record the year in Notes. Every measurement needs a precise source location.
Use Needs review for a first-pass collection. Select Reviewed only after checking the source, conditions and structure. Unreviewed structures do not enter default retrieval.
All examples are fictional format demonstrations. They are not literature or experimental evidence. The importer reads only Reaction contexts and Measurements.
There are 200 prepared rows with dropdowns. Copy the last row formatting to extend the table. The importer reads all nonempty rows. Keep one header row and avoid merged cells.
Choose a curator prefix, such as WK_ or EM_, for all your IDs. Assign papers before starting. Workbooks can be merged; conflicting rows are never silently overwritten.
Start with about five primary papers, one or two contexts per paper and three to six key assays. Add multiple measurement rows when an assay has several metrics.
